title: Kujh Balaaan Aan Sakina Nu Aye Puchiya
body:
Kyun Zakhmi Ne Kan Tere Kyun Neelay Ne Rukhsar.
<<DIVIDER>>
Ki Wekhiya Toon Karbal Jo Bujh Gayi Aye Binai.
Kis Sham De Dukh Wich Tere Walaan Che Safeedi Aayi.
Kadi Char Baras De Bachey Aynj Honday Nayi Beemar.
<<DIVIDER>>
Aye Sang Te Sir Aye Kis Da Chan Chodhvin Da Jo Disda.
Hontaan Te Tabasum Tari Te Khon Galay Choon Risda.
Kisay Zalim Aidhay Gal Te Kita Aye Teer Da Waar.
<<DIVIDER>>
Fair Sain Sakina Boli Pehchan Karawan Apni.
Ditti Fidak Di Paishi Jis Ne Oh Dadi Zahra Meri.
Assan Dhiyaan Oss Toon Sikhiya Kinj Jana Aye Darbar.
<<DIVIDER>>
Jiday Athro Band Na Hon Aye Jinno Sir Sangaan Te Roon Aye.
Kis Dil Nal Dasaan Loko Nizay Te Mera Kon Aye.
Seene Te Sawawan Wala Mera Piyo Mera Sardar.
<<DIVIDER>>
:AKBAR: Kahway Sain Sakina Aanda Aye Waqt Kadi Na.
Sadha Man Si Chacha Ghazi Jay Kar Ohh Jonda Honda.
Main Takdi Kiwein Hasday Aye Shami Wich Bazar.
